smell_validity.evidence: Pasted helper bodies sit inside orchestration loops while the helpers still serve other callers, so the healthy boundary and its inlined twin are directly comparable. One JSON-escape policy becomes two copies in the params loop and the flag/retry logic repeats with drift already visible (the inline retry omits the GET_EMPTY branch), exposing the central cost of deep inlining.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Any change to pair decode/normalize, part-fetch flag composition or JSON escaping must now be edited at up to three inline copies across ingestion, --replace, set and both output paths. Unrelated details (libcurl flag selection, escape tables) clutter every per-URL loop read, and restoring single owners removes a lasting stale-copy trap.

development_plausibility.evidence: Real libcurl idioms, existing goto-cleanup style, -Wshadow-driven z-prefixed locals and unrolled retries fit the file; the call-depth rationale reads like genuine performance-shaped maintenance. Mild scaffolding remains in comments that explicitly recite the former helper lineage (addqpair, memdupzero, memdupdec, decodequery, encodequery).

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Names every affected area, forbids first-spot-only cleanup, and pins the costly invariants: byte-identical JSON, + versus %2B decoding, null-byte conversion only in display forms, and the retry-then-disabled puny2idn behavior. This decisively blocks wrong-direction rewrites and partial cleanup while leaving helper boundaries open to sound designs.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five distinct purposes: pair extraction (wrapper structs freed while arrays keep strings), replace normalize (zfail frees everything and yields NULL), component set (variable-table scan plus conditional precheck ordering), part fetch (retry mutating persistent option state), and escaping (per-byte transform). Each needs its own ownership, cleanup or ordering decision.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names areas, not blocks; classifying fetch sites requires option-state flag selection and qpairsdec data flow across pipeline stages. Adjacent legitimate helper calls that must be excluded (the retained memdupdec for pdec, other direct jsonString uses) are plausible look-alikes.

repair_coordination.evidence: Extraction and replace must keep one normalize rule; if only one copy changes, --replace-written pairs diverge from ingested pairs and JSON output breaks. The two escape copies and two fetch sites likewise share one policy each, so single-site repair leaves inconsistent copies.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Of roughly seven inlined sites, the best uniform rule (replace the inline flag/retry block with a geturlpart call) covers only the two fetch sites, under 40%. Escape, set and pair clusters reconnect to different helpers with site-specific buffers, lengths and ownership.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A refactored helper that skips persisting the cleared puny2idn option or moves the display-only null-byte conversion still passes ordinary URLs and only fails on punycode-failing hosts or null-byte query values. Both are special state; score-4 unchecked-path evidence is not available.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
